title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Rider: Alert Amounts, Alert Channels and Disconnect Warning Days
content:
PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) watches every prepaid balance with a low-balance alert amount, chosen by the member within the tier's range or set at the tier default, and with a disconnect warning sent when the projected days of balance remaining fall to the tier's warning days. The projection averages the daily charges of the tier's projection history.

| Tier | Default alert amount (USD) | Lowest alert amount (USD) | Highest alert amount (USD) | Repeat alert after (elapsed hours) | Disconnect warning at days remaining | Projection history (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential | 20.00 | 10.00 | 100.00 | 24 | 3 | 7 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 | 20.00 | 10.00 | 100.00 | 24 | 3 | 7 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 | 20.00 | 10.00 | 100.00 | 24 | 3 | 7 |
| PrePay Power Seasonal | 25.00 | 10.00 | 100.00 | 24 | 3 | 7 |
| PrePay Power Outbuilding | 15.00 | 10.00 | 100.00 | 24 | 3 | 7 |
| PrePay Power Small Commercial | 75.00 | 25.00 | 500.00 | 24 | 5 | 7 |

**Alert channels a member may choose**

| Tier | Channels |
|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential, PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25, PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40, PrePay Power Seasonal, PrePay Power Outbuilding | text, email, text and email, phone call |
| PrePay Power Small Commercial | email, text and email |

Hypothetical reading: on PrePay Power Small Commercial an alert amount of 25.00 or 500.00 lies within the range and 24.99 does not; a phone call channel is not offered on that tier.
